أحترس (form VIII)
# أَحْتَرِسُ (ʔaḥtarisu) /ʔaħ.ta.ri.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَسَ (iḥtarasa)
# أَحْتَرِسَ (ʔaḥtarisa) /ʔaħ.ta.ri.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَرَسَ (iḥtarasa)
# أَحْتَرِسْ (ʔaḥtaris) /ʔaħ.ta.ris/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِحْتَرَسَ (iḥtarasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
